primary_question: Can a fixed collection yield verifiable, nontrivial positive and sensitive-negative trajectories in both environments?

actor.sampling_policy: one sample per turn, same preassigned seed for both conditions of an instance

sampling: fixed full schedule, no label-based selection, no replacement or replenishment
analysis_unit: task instance block; two actor conditions share public task and state
novelty_scope: new task instances and multi-action configurations, not unseen authorization rules

readiness_screen_only.failure_action: report shortfalls and stop; do not generate replacements
readiness_screen_only.passing_action: eligible to plan a separate monitor development comparison, not a power or efficacy claim
